# Debrid Hub

> Self-hosted aggregator for debrid services (Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, TorBox). Shows
> every link across your accounts as one normalized list, groups TV episodes into
> series/seasons, shows quality/language badges, dedups the same release across
> providers, resolves direct download URLs on demand, lets you delete items, and
> feeds URLs to JDownloader2. A separate Discover surface browses/searches content
> via Stremio-protocol addons and can push a chosen release into a debrid account.
> One Python package = web UI + REST API + CLI.

Key facts for agents:
- Stateless server: everything to resolve or delete a link is encoded in its opaque
  base64url `id`. Ids are recomputed on each listing.
- Optional auth: if `DEBRID_HUB_API_KEY` is set, send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
- Deletion is irreversible; AllDebrid magnets and all TorBox items delete the whole
  torrent/magnet (every file inside). The `mock` provider is a safe delete target.
- Provider APIs change upstream (e.g. AllDebrid split /magnet/status into
  /v4.1/magnet/status + /v4/magnet/files). A provider section failure is recorded
  in `Provider.warnings` and surfaced via `errors[provider]`, never swallowed
  silently. `?debug=true` on `/api/links` (or `--debug`, or the UI's Debug button)
  shows every outbound request/response made while listing, secrets redacted.
- Try with no keys: `DEBRID_HUB_MOCK=1 debrid-hub serve`.
- Docker deploys pull `ghcr.io/ferrandj/debrid-hub` (published by CI on every
  push to master, amd64+arm64); updating is `docker compose pull && docker
  compose up -d`. There is intentionally no way to push code into a running
  container from the UI/API — that would be remote code execution.
- Discover addon manifest URLs are secrets (often embed a personal config
  token) -- encrypted like provider keys (`AddonStore`, `addons.enc`), never
  returned by any endpoint once stored. Streams are opaque tokens too; a
  chosen stream's real url is only resolved server-side, host-validated
  against the addon it claims to be from, before being fetched. No
  addon-specific code exists anywhere -- `addons.py` implements the open
  Stremio protocol generically, so any addon a user adds just works.
- "Add to debrid" from Discover = fetching a stream's own url server-side
  (`POST /api/discover/add`) -- for a debrid-integrated addon, that's the
  exact action that resolves/caches the release into the user's account, same
  as hitting Play in Stremio. Irreversible in the same sense as any debrid
  add. Querying streams/search/catalog has no such side effect.

## Docs
- [Product & architecture](docs/PRODUCT.md): concepts, request flow, providers, grouping, settings, extending.
- [REST API reference](docs/API.md): endpoints, request/response shapes, errors, examples.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](docs/openapi.json): machine-readable schema (served live at `/openapi.json`, Swagger UI at `/docs`).
- [README](README.md): install, quick start, keys, CLI.

## API surface
- `GET /api/providers` — providers, health, capabilities (e.g. `["delete"]`)
- `GET /api/links?search=&provider=&kind=&sort=&order=&refresh=&debug=` — normalized listing; `debug=true` adds raw request/response log
- `POST /api/resolve` `{ids:[...]}` — link ids → direct URLs
- `POST /api/delete` `{ids:[...]}` — delete links from provider accounts (irreversible)
- `GET /api/config` / `PUT /api/config` / `DELETE /api/config/{provider}` — encrypted key management (never returns key values)
- `POST /api/config/reload` — re-read the encrypted store from disk and rebuild live providers (pick up a key written out-of-band, e.g. via `docker compose exec`)
- `GET /health` — liveness
- `GET|POST|DELETE /api/addons` — list/add/remove Stremio-protocol addon manifest URLs (encrypted, never returned)
- `GET /api/discover/catalogs|catalog|search|meta|streams` — browse/search/enrich content across configured addons
- `POST /api/discover/add` `{token:"..."}` — resolve a chosen stream (adds it to a debrid account for debrid-integrated addons)

## CLI
- `debrid-hub providers | list [--debug] | resolve <id> | rm <id> [-y] | serve`
- `debrid-hub config set|list|remove|path`

## Source layout
- `src/debrid_hub/models.py` — DebridLink, id encode/decode
- `src/debrid_hub/aggregator.py` — fan-out, cache, resolve/delete routing
- `src/debrid_hub/providers/` — one module per provider (subclass `Provider`)
- `src/debrid_hub/api.py` — FastAPI app + request models
- `src/debrid_hub/cli.py` — Typer CLI
- `src/debrid_hub/web/index.html` — self-contained web UI (series grouping + Discover UI live here)
- `src/debrid_hub/store.py` / `config.py` — encrypted secret store (provider keys + addon URLs), settings
- `src/debrid_hub/addons.py` — generic Stremio-protocol HTTP client (manifest/catalog/meta/stream)
- `src/debrid_hub/discover.py` — DiscoverHub: orchestrates addons.py + AddonStore, opaque stream tokens
